selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSAS-01 → MSAS-03 → MSAS-04 → MSAS-05 → MSAS-07 → MSAS-09 → MSAS-12 → MSAS-14 → MSAS-15 → MSAS-18 → MSAS-21

objective: Implement spatial-audio authoring and listener preview for emitters, zones and occlusion over explicit map/world/scene projections and AAI audio semantics, while keeping spatial placement a presentation projection rather than World truth and remaining usable without proprietary middleware.
boundaries: MSAS-01/MSAS-03/MSAS-04/MSAS-05/MSAS-07/MSAS-09/MSAS-12 remain prior studio, semantic and voice-production foundations consumed by this tranche.
MCS/World/Environment/Location/Scene owners retain canonical geometry, placement, visibility and scene-state truth; MSAS-14 may consume explicit projections but cannot create or mutate them.
AAI retains canonical audio semantic and runtime playback/layering/mixer authority.
Spatial emitter placement is an audio presentation projection, not World placement truth.
Zone/listener/occlusion preview must keep unsupported or unavailable geometry explicit rather than fabricate spatial truth.
Preview may use synthetic or permission-filtered owner projections but cannot infer hidden gameplay/world state from audio configuration.
Spatial preview remains blocking-capable without proprietary middleware or paid/cloud providers.
Meaningful spatial/sonic information retains non-audio accessibility alternatives where applicable.
MSAS-15+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
